coastal.title: Investigators called in after multiple fires ignite in wildfire-ravaged Boston Bar
coastal.description: A spokesperson with the Fraser Valley Regional District would not say how many fires were burning or if a suspected arsonist is at work.

coastal.title: Wildfire north of Sooke, B.C., burning out of control
coastal.description: The Mount Jack Wildfire on Southern Vancouver Island is still classified as out of control by the B.C. Wildfire Services. It was discovered on Sept. 20 and has grown to at least 210 hectares in size. Part of The Galloping Goose Trail has been closed as precaution.

coastal.title: Girlfriend of B.C.'s Hudson Williams says Heated Rivalry fans crossing 'huge boundary'
coastal.description: Katelyn Larson, a Vancouver-based tattoo artist, made a rare statement about her relationship with Hudson Williams, calling out Heated Rivalry fans for their parasocial behaviour.

coastal.title: First Nations in B.C. Interior feel 'fear and scarcity' amidst drought-stricken salmon run
coastal.description: With this year's low water levels and high temperatures, algae and contaminants in the watershed are a key concern along with fish spawning.

southeast.title: District of Squamish rejects $142M Woodfibre LNG deal
southeast.description: The District of Squamish has rejected a negotiated 10-year tax settlement that would have seen Woodfibre LNG contributing $142 million to the community in the Sea-to-Sky region.

all.title: Feds open up Trans Mountain equity stake to Indigenous groups on pipeline’s path
all.description: The federal government has offered Indigenous groups a collective 15 per cent ownership stake in the Trans Mountain pipeline, advancing a long-promised plan to give First Nations equity in the federally owned infrastructure connecting Alberta crude to a Vancouver-area export terminal.
